name: get-environment-release-plans
description: Get environment release plans, reusable progressive-release recipes. Beta API. Without releasePlanKey: a page ordered by creation time with totalCount; when hasMore is true, pass nextOffset as offset. With releasePlanKey: one plan with its phases (clauses and steps), metrics, randomizationUnit, advancementMode, and cleanupBehavior.

environmentKey.description: Environment key. If the user hasn't named one, ask; don't guess.

offset.description: Only without releasePlanKey. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

projectKey.description: Project key. If the user hasn't named a project, do not ask yet: list projects with get-projects first. If exactly one exists, use it, but name it and confirm it with the user before any write. If there are more, ask; don't guess.

releasePlanKey.description: Get one plan. Omit to list plans.

name: get-flag-release-plans
description: Get flag release plans, reusable templates that say how a flag is released across a project's environments. Beta API. Without flagReleasePlanKey: a page in creation order with totalCount; when hasMore is true, pass nextOffset as offset. With flagReleasePlanKey: one plan with its environments (environmentKey, triggerType, environmentReleasePlanKey or isImmediate), executionMode, applicationKeys, maintainer, default, and version. A maintainer reads as {kind: member, memberId, email} or {kind: team, key, name}; to send a team maintainer to update-flag-release-plan, use {kind: team, teamKey: <key>}. The plan with default: true is the project's default, suggested first when starting a release. A project with no stored plans has no default; create a plan with default: true. Flag release plans are project-wide; environment release plans (get-environment-release-plans) are the per-environment rollout recipes they point to.

flagReleasePlanKey.description: Get one plan. Omit to list plans.

offset.description: Only without flagReleasePlanKey. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

endingVariationId.description: The _id of the flag variation to release to.

environmentReleasePlanKey.description: Only with releaseType policy. Key of the environment release plan to release with instead of the environment's default plan; it must be a plan in this environment (see get-environment-release-plans). Omit to use the default plan.

override.description: Inline rollout for releaseType override. Keys are camelCase exactly as named here (releaseMethod, rolloutContextKindKey, stages, metricKeys, metricGroupKeys, rollbackOnRegression), not the snake_case names get-automated-rollout-config returns. For an immediate release, omit override and releaseType and pass only environmentKey.

metricGroupKeys.description: Metric groups that gate a guarded rollout.

metricKeys.description: Metrics that gate a guarded rollout. Guarded needs metricKeys or metricGroupKeys.

releaseMethod.description: immediate turns the flag on and takes no stages or metrics; progressive ramps through stages; guarded ramps through stages gated on metrics.

rollbackOnRegression.description: Roll back automatically when a guarded metric regresses.

rolloutContextKindKey.description: Context kind the rollout allocates by.

stages.description: Required for progressive and guarded. Allocations must be positive and strictly increasing. Guarded caps every stage at 50000 and promotes to 100% after the last stage, so do not add a 100000 stage; progressive usually ends at 100000. Each stage has exactly allocation and durationMillis, e.g. {"allocation":10000,"durationMillis":3600000} for 10% over one hour.

allocation.description: Thousandths of a percent: 100000 is 100%, 10000 is 10%, 1000 is 1%.

durationMillis.description: Monitoring window in milliseconds. Must be greater than 0 for every stage, including the last.

releaseType.description: Only override or policy. override (default) pins the rollout in override; policy waits for the PR merge and the flag's first evaluation, then releases with the environment's default release plan, or the plan environmentReleasePlanKey names; it releases on merge and never holds. Do not pass override with policy. immediate, progressive, and guarded are override.releaseMethod values.

triggerType.description: flag_eval starts after the flag is seen evaluating; webhook waits for a CI/CD deploy signal; manual waits for a person to start it; promotion starts when the previous environment finishes. waitBeforeReleaseMillis.description: Delay after the preceding environment finishes. Dropped from the first environment.

executionMode.description: Only with kind custom. Environments release in array order. sequential is the only mode, and the default.

flagReleasePlanKey.description: Only with kind plan, and required there. Do not send it with environments.

kind.description: plan follows the flag release plan flagReleasePlanKey names. custom releases the environments you list, with no flag release plan. Optional: without kind, flagReleasePlanKey means plan and environments means custom.

name: create-automated-rollout-config
description: Record an automated rollout config for a feature-flagged change. Use it only for AutomatedRollout requests. The guarding flag must already exist. Pass repoFullName, prNumber, and prUrl for the PR the user names or you just filed; omit them when there is none. Each listed environment releases after the merge, pinned in override or by a release plan; to hold one, leave it out (no hold or date field exists). releaseType is only override or policy; immediate, progressive, and guarded are override.releaseMethod values. An immediate release passes only environmentKey, with no releaseType or override. triggerType: flag_eval (default), webhook (CI/CD deploy), manual, or promotion. Stages have exactly allocation and durationMillis; allocation is thousandths of a percent, so 10% over one hour is {"allocation":10000,"durationMillis":3600000}. override keys are camelCase: releaseMethod, rolloutContextKindKey, stages, metricKeys, rollbackOnRegression. policy uses the environment's default release plan, or the plan environmentReleasePlanKey names. Surface every warning in generated comments; do not call a warned environment a clean rollout. Returns config_id, the stored config, and warnings.

name: get-automated-rollout-config
description:
Fetch a single automated rollout config by id to verify its state.

Use this after create-automated-rollout-config (which returns config_id) to confirm the rollout was recorded and to check its progress.

LIFECYCLE:
- pr_state: "pending" until the guarding PR merges, then "merged".
- status: "active" while releasing, then "complete", "expired", or "archived".

The config reports its execution_mode. Each environment reports its desired_release_type, environment_release_plan_key (a policy environment that names a plan other than the default), trigger_type, wait_before_release_millis, the pinned override (if any), and release progress via released_at and associated_release_id (both set once the environment's release starts). An environment is editable with update-automated-rollout-config only while its status is "pending" and release_lifecycle_status is "not_started".

INPUTS:
- projectKey (required): LaunchDarkly project key (e.g., "default").
- configId (required): The rollout config id returned by create-automated-rollout-config.

RETURNS:
- found: Boolean; false when no config with that id exists for the project's account.
- config: The rollout config when found — { id, project_key, flag_key, repo_full_name, pr_number, pr_url, pr_state, status, execution_mode, required_application_keys, created_at, updated_at, completed_at, environments: [{ environment_key, desired_release_type, environment_release_plan_key, trigger_type, status, release_lifecycle_status, wait_before_release_millis, associated_release_id, released_at, override: { release_method, rollout_context_kind_key, stages, metric_keys, metric_group_keys, rollback_on_regression } }] }.

name: update-environment-release-plan
description: Update an environment release plan's name, description, or progressive-release configuration. Beta API. Send only the fields to change; omitted fields keep their current values, including inside progressiveRelease, so a single field such as advancementMode or cleanupBehavior can be changed on its own without reading the plan first. progressiveRelease.phases and progressiveRelease.metrics are each replaced wholesale when provided, so include every phase or metric to keep. Editing a plan changes what releases started from it will do. progressiveRelease follows the same rules as in create-environment-release-plan. To change the environment's default plan, use update-default-environment-release-plan. The response lists the fields whose values changed and the plan as read back after the update.

environmentKey.description: Environment key. If the user hasn't named one, ask; don't guess.

progressiveRelease.description: Only the fields to change; omitted fields keep their current values. phases and metrics each replace the whole value when provided.

name: delete-environment-release-plan
description: Permanently delete an environment release plan. Beta API. Releases already started from it keep running, and its key can be reused afterward. Deleting the environment's default plan leaves the environment without a default. A plan that flag release plans still name cannot be deleted; the error names those plans. Point their environment at another plan or set isImmediate, or delete those plans, in LaunchDarkly or with update-flag-release-plan and delete-flag-release-plan when they are available; then delete this plan again. This check does not cover flag releases already running: an environment that a release has not reached yet looks this plan up by key when the release reaches it, and that environment fails if the plan is gone, so check for active releases first.

name: update-automated-rollout-config
description: Modify an automated rollout config that has not started releasing. Pass only what changes: environments, repoFullName, prNumber, or prUrl; omitted fields stay as they are. environments REPLACES the whole ordered plan, so an environment you omit is removed: read the config with get-automated-rollout-config, edit that list, and send it back complete. An environment sent without triggerType keeps its stored trigger_type, including manual and promotion; a newly added one starts on flag_eval. Each environment takes the shape create-automated-rollout-config accepts: releaseType is override (default) or policy, never immediate, so an immediate release passes only environmentKey. The config must be active with an unmerged PR, and an environment is editable only while its status is "pending" and release_lifecycle_status is "not_started". Otherwise LaunchDarkly returns a conflict, which is terminal: do not retry. Returns updated and the config as stored.
